CRM notes (fragments):

- POC summary: ran hosted API POC on ~50k docs; relevance good, latencies avg p50=120ms for embedding queries in hosted trial.
- Performance targets: p95 generation < 300ms for short responses, steady throughput target ~40–60 qps for support assistant during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: budget-conscious — target ARR spend ~75k-150k; asking for committed discount scenarios.

- Open items: Redwood to provide SOC2 controls matrix, SAML IdP integration guide, Dedicated pricing tiers (committed qps + burst), and proposed SLA language.
- Risk: finance pushing for lower committed spend; infra team has strict VPC peering rules (no inbound tunnels) which may complicate Dedicated topology.
- Quote from Head of Platform (Jason): 'If we can get a predictable bill and audit logs, we'll move Dedicated — otherwise we stay on hosted'.
- Next: deliver SOC2 pack + 3 pricing scenarios + schedule technical VPC workshop (target week of 2024-11-11).
summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS. Completed hosted POC; now evaluating Dedicated (VPC). Primary blockers are SOC2 evidence and VPC peering architecture. High chance to convert if pricing + SOC2/SSO answers delivered.
